setup.title: Connection data
setup.rscp-info: ATTENTION: The RSCP connection must first be activated on the home power station. To do this, go to the "Main menu", "Personalization", "User profile". There you can set the RSCP password on the second page and thus activate access.

summary.info: This device displays the HPS data over the selected time period
summary.title: Overview

repair.title: Repair connection
repair.info: Check or update RSCP credentials (e.g. new IP). Test the connection, then press Next to save — no need to re-add the device.

errors.missing-kwp: Please configure at least one PV surface (kWp, tilt, compass) — enter each roof or wall section separately.
errors.missing-location: No location: enter latitude and longitude in device settings or set location under Homey → Settings → General (app “Location” permission required).

ems.intro: EMS triggers connect E3DC with external apps (Ultimate EMS, Power by the Hour, Tibber, …). PV surplus and SoC thresholds on the HPS; wallbox ready on the wallbox device.

messages.hps-not-available: Error accessing the home power station. Check the connection settings.
messages.hps-device-not-found: The Homey device of the home power station has been removed. Add the statistic device again.
messages.invalid-percentage: The percentage value must be >= 0 and <= 100.
messages.requested-max-charging-power-to-high: The requested maximum charging power of __REQUESTED__ watts is higher than the permitted maximum of __MAX__ watts of the home power station.
messages.requested-max-charging-power-to-low: The requested maximum charging power of __REQUESTED__ watts is lower than the permitted minimum of __MIN__ watts of the home power station.
messages.requested-max-charging-power-denied-by-h: The home power station has rejected the requested value of maximum charging power. Response: __RESULTCODE__
messages.removal-of-all-powerlimits-denied-by-hps: The home power station has refused to remove the power limits. Answer: Maximum charging limit: __CHARGING_RESULTCODE__, Maximum discharge limit: __DISCHARGING_RESULTCODE__, Start value: __START_RESULTCODE__, Switches: __SWITCH_RESULTCODE__
messages.requested-max-discharging-power-to-high: The requested maximum discharging power of __REQUESTED__ watts is higher than the permitted maximum of __MAX__ watts of the home power station.
messages.requested-max-discharging-power-to-low: The requested maximum discharging power of __REQUESTED__ watts is lower than the permitted minimum of __MIN__ watts of the home power station.
messages.requested-max-discharging-power-denied-b: The home power station has rejected the requested value of maximum discharging power. Response: __RESULTCODE__
messages.activating-of-powerlimits-failed-by-hps: The home power station has refused to activate the charge/discharge limits. Response: __RESULTCODE__
messages.deactivating-of-powerlimits-failed-by-hp: The home power station has refused to deactivate the charge/discharge limits. Response: __RESULTCODE__
messages.manual-charge-input-wrong-wh-to-low: An energy quantity of at least __MIN__Wh must be specified
messages.manual-charge-capacity-unknown: The usable battery capacity is unknown. Percent cannot be converted to Wh.
messages.manual-charge-rejected-by-hps: Manual storage tank charging was rejected by the home power station without explanation. A charge may have already been carried out today
messages.manual-charge-already-running: A manual charging process is already active
messages.wallbox-mix-rejected: E3/DC rejected “battery discharge in mixed mode”
messages.wallbox-sun-discharge-rejected: E3/DC rejected “battery discharge in sun mode”
messages.wallbox-sun-mode-rejected: Wallbox rejected the sun mode command
messages.wallbox-current-rejected: Wallbox rejected the command (check RSCP connection / permissions)

timeline.plan-discharge-set: Charge plan set “discharge battery until” to __PERCENT__%
timeline.plan-discharge-restored: Charge plan ended – “discharge battery until” restored to __PERCENT__%
timeline.plan-battery-to-car-set: Charge plan set “battery for car” to __STATE__
timeline.plan-battery-to-car-restored: Charge plan ended – “battery for car” restored to __STATE__
timeline.plan-battery-before-car-set: Charge plan set “car before battery” to __STATE__
timeline.plan-battery-before-car-restored: Charge plan ended – “car before battery” restored to __STATE__
timeline.plan-mix-set: Charge plan set mixed-mode discharge to __STATE__
timeline.plan-mix-restored: Charge plan ended – mixed-mode discharge restored

info.nothing-to-display: All elements are currently hidden. Check the widget configuration.
info.no-plant-id: No home power station has been selected. Select a home power station in the widget settings.
info.plant-not-found: The configured home power station was not found. Select the desired home power station in the widget settings.
info.no-plants: No home power stations are configured. First add a home power station device.
info.data-receive-error: The energy data could not be read.

wallbox.during-mix: During mixed mode, hold time, timer
wallbox.select-plant: Open the widget settings and select a home power station.
wallbox.several-plants: Several home power stations found – the first one is used.
wallbox.no-wallbox: No wallbox is configured for the selected home power station.
wallbox.api-error: API error. Check the widget settings.
wallbox.current-range: Max charging current must be between 6 and 16 A.
wallbox.discharge-range: Discharge battery until must be between 0 and 100 %.

hkw-plan.notice: Active charge plans take precedence over flows. While a plan is running, flow commands for power modes are ignored.
hkw-plan.end-or-soc: Enter an end time or enable "Until SOC"
hkw-plan.end-after-start: The end must be after the start

wb-plan.notice: Active plans take precedence. Flows for charging, sun mode and current are ignored while a plan is running.
wb-plan.notice-restore: “Discharge home battery until” is set only for this plan and is restored to the original value when the plan ends.
wb-plan.discharge-hint: Only for the duration of this plan. The original value is restored automatically afterwards.
wb-plan.no-wallbox: No wallbox found for this home power station
wb-plan.restore-note: (restored to the original value when the plan ends)
wb-plan.end-or-full: Enter an end time or enable "Until full"
wb-plan.end-after-start: The end must be after the start
